The House Ways and Means Committee has advanced a new crypto tax bill, the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act (H.R. 10357), by a 38–5 vote.
The headline: 👇
💰 Crypto users could get clearer tax rules for everyday transactions.
⚡ The bill would create a $10 exemption for qualifying network and transaction fees, helping reduce the tax-compliance headache around tiny crypto transactions.
📊 It also addresses stablecoins, mining, staking, lending, broker reporting and wash-sale rules, bringing several digital-asset tax rules closer to the framework used for traditional financial assets.
But this is not law yet.
The bill has only cleared the House committee and still needs to move through the House and Senate before it could reach the President.
Still, after the recent setback for the broader CLARITY Act, this is another important signal that crypto taxation remains a major legislative focus in Washington. 🇺🇸
Now the question is simple:
